title: Don't call him an ass. He's smarter than you 🫏
caption:
Stubborn? No. He's thinking 🫏🧠
Tag someone who needs to hear this 👇
sources: The Donkey Sanctuary (UK): donkeys are not stubborn; strong self-preservation instinct; they freeze and assess rather than flee; long memories for places and companions; the bray carries far
Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'donkey' (descended from African wild asses of dry, desert regions)
